about: How the public pages SPEAK about the catalog. pricing/catalog.json is owned by TorontoLeads and copied here byte for byte; it holds every price, minute count and trial term. This file holds only the wording wrapped around them -- plan names, taglines, the feature lines on each card, section notes and the plain-language rules. Deliberately no prices, minute counts or trial terms: pricing_data.check() fails the build if a figure appears here, so a number can still only be changed in one place.
tax_note: All prices in CAD, plus applicable taxes.

annual.label: 2 months free
annual.terms: Annual is 2 months free, with your rate locked for the term. Cancelling takes effect at the end of the term; unused months are not refunded.

alerts.about: TODO(owner): the usage-alert thresholds are the one product figure with no home in the canonical catalog. They are the dashboard's to own; they live here until TorontoLeads adds them, and pricing_data.check() exempts this block from the no-figures rule by name.

rules.minute_definition: A minute is time our assistant spends on a live call, including transfers.
rules.not_billable: Spam calls and calls under {billable_min_seconds} seconds are never billed.
rules.no_carry_over: Packages apply to the month you buy them in. Unused minutes do not carry over.
rules.business_never_stops: Business plans never stop answering. If you run out, we add your plan's package automatically and let you know.
rules.personal_out_of_minutes: Personal Line: without a package, callers past your minutes hear a short message that you can't take the call right now.
rules.setup: Setup is included. We configure the assistant on your existing number. About 10 minutes of your time.
rules.no_contracts: No long-term contracts; cancel a monthly plan anytime.
rules.packages_from_dashboard: Extra minutes come in packages, bought from your dashboard.

extra_plan_aliases.about: Short ?plan= values that have been linked to from live pages and emails but are not in the canonical legacy_map. Kept so old links keep resolving. TODO(owner): fold these into legacy_map in TorontoLeads and delete this block.
